scope: Physical, instrumented, telemetry-driven manual races; no demo/autosteer. Lap crossings interpolate MOS ticks at 120 Hz and have one telemetry interval uncertainty. Clean excludes contacts and grass; kerb use is recorded separately. Centre occupancy uses left-held samples weighted by MOS-clock intervals; 16 world units is a reporting band on the 180-unit-wide road. Steering step and corner reserve vary between trials and are recorded per run; grip groups are not controlled single-variable comparisons. Pass sides interpolate relative lateral position at observed longitudinal crossings; they are left/right, without inferring inside/outside from a corner label. Intervals describe delivered telemetry observations, not physical VDP completion or production FPS. These results describe this controller, not a human difficulty threshold.
